Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Hospital patient whose tracker has 2 active rows and 1 held row; NH variant: resident with 1 active and 1 held row

When Ask preset "What medications is the patient on?"

Then Answer lists the active drugs and marks the held drug as held

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): All rows named and the held drug together with 'held' (U5). Which drug the word 'held' sits next to is read from the quoted answer; S07 asks it as an unambiguous question
